scope: Pre-launch independent code review and bounded synthetic verification only. No model training, cloud launch or network.

resolved_findings.resolution: Full review stays local; payload contains only allowlisted data-gate.json receipt. Final decoded ZIP verified.

checks.training_data: Only original official train + frozen 10073-row public pool, plus 120 raw Luna/Terra rows in add120. No holdout or paired diagnostic text in uploaded package.
checks.vocabulary: StyleGrams.fit receives only current fold official training rows + baseline extra (+ new120 for add120). Validation text only transformed in this vocabulary. Separate text-only validation clustering is the unchanged transductive inference policy.
checks.weights: Independent extraction of old weights function: all 5 fold control arrays exactly equal. All old-row weights bitwise equal in both arms. New rows use original per-class public weight without renormalization.
checks.new_grouping: New rows form separate codex namespace and matrix block; 60 groups, each one Luna and one Terra. Group means cannot absorb old public rows.
checks.folds: Official frozen folds SHA e8ba1e3712852168dc57f56960d4f3e00be612d639ade8a7dcb0f0d8335ce551, original 2699-row order/text hashes checked; prompt groups do not cross folds.
checks.sparse_order: Independent old/new function comparison on actual official folds: all 75 m=2/3/6 x repeat=0..4 x 5-fold selections exactly equal. Selected texts are regrouped before centering, paired selection shared across arms.
checks.baseline_recipe: Frozen core, float64, LinearSVC C=.5 dual=True max_iter=4000 random_state=42, two threads, unchanged original data/order/weights. Both arms executed in one process and environment; actual numerical parity with historical control remains a post-run gate.
checks.environment: Runner strict cloud preflight requires numpy2.1.3 pandas2.3.3 scipy1.16.3 sklearn1.6.1 and rejects /dev/nvidia0. Those package versions match old runtime receipt. Local preflight was non-strict and is not cloud environment proof.
checks.guard: Existing frozen guard uses exclusive output claim, one subprocess, 6600-second/20GiB sampled-RSS budget, no retry, requires child exit0 and COMPLETE stable artifact inventory, retains errors. Notebook archives outputs in finally.
checks.launch: One QuickSave then one full-run request, durable in-flight state before each request, no retry loop. Readback binds source/privacy/CPU/internet/input refs/image. Actual installed ApiSaveKernelResponse supports url and other used fields.
checks.artifact_identity: Runner JSON/NPZ carry run_id/config_sha256/runner_sha256, finite score checks, stage receipts and stable byte-hashed manifest.

residual_risks: Training and cloud execution were not run by reviewer. PASS is not an OOF result, numerical baseline reproduction, leaderboard improvement or end-to-end Kaggle success.
Local preflight uses different package versions with strict_environment=false; strict runtime environment evidence is required from actual cloud run.
Known/exact data separation does not establish exhaustive semantic independence or authenticated backend snapshot; new labels remain requested_only.
Official folds have been inspected before and are development OOF, not a fresh holdout. The retained 60-row new holdout is not evaluated.
Adding rows changes candidate vocabulary/IDF and total Luna/Terra weight mass by design; observed effect is this full data-addition intervention, not isolated semantics.
RSS enforcement is sampled and budget abort may leave partial output; accept only complete 5-fold/two-arm/20-fit artifacts and guard COMPLETE with clean child exit.
Historical control score/prediction and sparse-output reproduction must be checked after completion before interpreting candidate gain; unexpected drift blocks interpretation, not auto-rerun.
post_run_acceptance: Bind downloaded outputs to this run/config/runner and verify stable manifest bytes.
Require guard/result/state COMPLETE, child_exit=0, no termination/failure, actual strict environment accepted.
Require both arms 2699-row 18-column finite OOF with exact ID/label/fold mapping and all 150 arm-specific sparse files.
Compare control with frozen EXP010 share0.5 dense/sparse outputs and investigate unexplained score or prediction drift before comparative claims.
Compute 18-class pooled OOF and paired official-prompt bootstrap only after source acceptance; no automatic rerun or hyperparameter search.
